hooks.command: f=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); case "$f" in *.sh) bash -n "$f"; shellcheck "$f" ;; esac; true

root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); f="$root/dietpi-wifi.txt"; if [[ -f "$f" ]] && grep -qE "a(WIFI_SSID|WIFI_KEY)\[[0-9]+\]='[^']+'" "$f"; then printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"dietpi-wifi.txt has non-empty WiFi credentials (aWIFI_SSID/aWIFI_KEY) - blank them before committing (see AGENTS.md)."}}'; fi
